title: BrowsMainer Online
description: BrowsMainer Online is a Minecraft plugin/mod that lets you use online browser features directly in Minecraft.
body:
# Mainbrows Online

**Mainbrows Online** brings real browser displays to Minecraft.
You can open and view websites directly inside your Minecraft world and watch them together with other players.

> **Status:** Mainbrows Online is currently in **alpha**. Bugs, changes, and limitations may still occur.

---

## What is Mainbrows Online?

**Mainbrows Online** is a browser display project for **Minecraft 1.21.11** with **Java 21**.

It allows you to create display surfaces in the world that work like a real browser.

In singleplayer, the browser runs locally through the **Fabric mod**.
On servers, the **Paper plugin** renders the website centrally and sends video and audio to players using the Fabric mod.

---

## Project Parts

| Part             | Description                                                           |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Fabric mod**   | Local displays in singleplayer and client support for server displays |
| **Paper plugin** | Shared server displays, permissions, sessions, and browser controls   |
| **Sidecar**      | Invisibly managed Chromium worker                                     |
| **Protocol**     | Shared message formats between the mod and plugin                     |

Chrome, Node, and FFmpeg do **not** need to be installed manually.
The required runtimes are downloaded and checked automatically on the first start.

---

## Features

### Browser Display

* Browser displays directly inside Minecraft
* Singleplayer displays through Fabric
* Shared server displays through Paper
* Open websites by URL
* Browser bar with:

  * Back
  * Forward
  * Reload
  * URL field
  * Ping display
  * Buffer status

### Quality and Performance

* Adjustable display quality
* Adjustable FPS:

  * 15 FPS
  * 30 FPS
  * 60 FPS
* Configurable viewer range
* Buffer system for smoother playback
* H.264 / Opus support
* JPEG / PCM fallback support

### Audio

* Audio streaming
* Volume control
* Audio device selection
* Audio modes:

  * Mono
  * Stereo
  * Off

### Server Features

* Permission system
* Session system
* Owner, controller, and control request system
* Website blacklist for blocked domains
* Automatic runtime installation
* Checksum verification for downloaded runtimes

---

## Requirements

### Client

* Minecraft **1.21.11**
* Java **21**
* Fabric Loader **0.19.3 or newer**
* Fabric API
* Mainbrows Online Fabric mod

### Server Displays

For shared server displays, the server owner also needs:

* Paper server for Minecraft **1.21.11**
* Mainbrows Online Paper plugin
* Mainbrows Online Fabric mod installed on every client

### First Start

Internet access is required on the first browser start to download the required runtimes.

---

## Getting Started

### 1. Install the mod

Install:

* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Mainbrows Online Fabric mod

### 2. Start Minecraft

Start Minecraft with the Fabric profile.

### 3. Create a display

Use these commands:

```mcfunction
/display wand
/display create <Name>
```

### 4. Open a website

```mcfunction
/display open <http(s)://URL>
```

### 5. Shared server displays

For shared displays, the server owner must also install the Paper plugin.

---

## Important Commands

| Command                                             | Description                          |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `/display wand`                                     | Gives you the display selection tool |
| `/display create <Name>`                            | Creates a new display                |
| `/display connect <Code>`                           | Connects to a server display         |
| `/display open <http(s)://URL>`                     | Opens a website                      |
| `/display quality <360p\|HD\|FullHD\|WidthxHeight>` | Changes display quality              |
| `/display fps <15\|30\|60>`                         | Changes display FPS                  |
| `/display range <2-128>`                            | Changes viewer range                 |
| `/display buffer <on seconds\|off>`                 | Enables or disables buffering        |
| `/display keyboard`                                 | Opens keyboard input                 |
| `/display browserstatus`                            | Shows browser status                 |
| `/display runtime retry`                            | Retries runtime installation         |
| `/display session clear`                            | Clears the current session           |

## Security and Privacy

All viewers of a server display see the same browser content and hear the same audio.

Because of this, you should **not** open the following on public server displays:

* Personal accounts
* Private messages
* Passwords
* Admin panels
* Sensitive data
* Private websites

For security reasons, these features are disabled in the shared server browser:

* Downloads
* File uploads
* Camera access
* Microphone access

Server admins can block websites through this file:

```text
plugins/Mainbrows/blocked-websites.json
```

In local singleplayer mode, browser data does not leave your own computer.

---

## Limitations

Mainbrows Online is still alpha software.
Some websites or systems may work better than others.

The following features are currently **best effort**:

* DRM / Widevine
* Captchas
* WebGL websites
* Very high resolutions
* Multiple displays at the same time
* 60 FPS on weaker systems

These features may require more CPU, RAM, and bandwidth:

* High resolution
* 60 FPS
* Multiple displays
* Fallback codecs
* Audio streaming

---

## Help and Bug Reports

When reporting bugs, please include:

* Mainbrows Online version
* Minecraft version
* Whether Fabric, Paper, or both are being used
* A short description of what happened
* The last steps before the issue occurred
* `logs/latest.log`

Before sending logs or screenshots, please remove:

* Login data
* Tokens
* Private browser content
* Personal information
